borrowable_patterns: workflow skill abstraction for repeatable protein-engineering flows
automatic MCP wrapper staging with strong fail-closed review
tool catalog as controlled radar instead of uncontrolled installation
status cache with TTL and file locking for slow runtime probes
sync-vs-submit API split for long-running protein jobs

source_level_risk_findings: pmcp create is an 8-step agentic wrapper pipeline and must be limited to sandboxed staging in KWB
run_claude_with_streaming invokes Claude Code CLI with --dangerously-skip-permissions, so KWB must not copy that execution policy into production workflows
Docker/GPU MCP definitions are useful as registry examples but require license, runtime, checksum, smoke, and explicit authorization before use
workflow skill installation as Markdown is useful, but KWB skills must produce receipts and validators rather than directly changing reviewed decisions or training labels
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat MCP installation as production approval
do not treat workflow execution as model-quality evidence
do not treat PLM/MSA fitness scores as wet-lab labels
do not let MCP tools write formal reviewed decisions or training imports
policy: Research summary only. It does not install ProteinMCP, enable external MCP tools, import labels, approve model claims, or release production functionality.
